counters.subtitle: Add what you want to count (e.g. Water), then add the Counter widget to your home screen. The widget counts one of them: tap it to add +1. Use −1 here if you tapped by mistake, or reset it to start again.
counters.empty: No counters yet. Add one above, then add the Counter widget from your home screen and choose this counter.
counters.remove.title: Remove counter
counters.remove.message: Remove "{{title}}"? The count ({{value}}) will be lost.
counters.hint.ios: Long-press home screen → + → search Until → add "Counter" widget.
counters.hint.android: Long-press home screen → Widgets → Until → Counter.
counters.limit.reached: That is the most one list holds ({{limit}}). Remove one to add another.
counters.limit.free: The free plan keeps one counter. Premium holds up to {{max}}.
counters.reset.title: Reset counter
counters.reset.message: Set "{{title}}" back to 0? It is at {{value}}.
